description: Targeted SchemaCompleteness probe contract plus a resumable full-catalog scan contract. Required probe rows are preflighted against the complete live catalog; successful per-action evidence preserves the canonical raw schema and its type-exact canonical JSON SHA-256 so every score can be independently rerun; full scans reuse only valid results from an identical input/catalog identity and publish a comparable summary only after every catalog action has exactly one valid result.

scoring.quality_pass_contract: A full-catalog action passes only when every applicable dimension is explicitly true (schema_score=1.0). A reusable fetch with any false applicable dimension is a quality failure.
scoring.fetch_failure_contract: failed_action_count and namespace failed_count describe schema fetch/execution failures; quality_pass_action_count and quality_fail_action_count describe schema contract quality.
scoring.param_gated_note: Param-gated dimensions are scored only for actions that declare parameters; param-less actions are N/A (excluded from the rate, never auto-1.0). A discover fetch failure is a hard fail, not N/A.

dimensions.name: param_types_declared
dimensions.description: Every parameter has a non-empty type field (N/A for param-less actions)

dimensions.name: required_params_marked
dimensions.description: Every parameter carries a boolean required flag (N/A for param-less actions)

dimensions.name: value_domain
dimensions.description: Every param is typed, described, and required-flagged, and constrained params document their allowed values (non-empty enum, numeric range). N/A for param-less actions

dimensions.name: planning_signals_present
dimensions.description: planning_signals key exists and is a non-empty list

dimensions.name: skill_routing_present
dimensions.description: skill key exists and is a non-empty string

dimensions.name: output_contract_declared
dimensions.description: output_contract_status is explicitly declared or not_declared

notes: Probe mode validates JSONL syntax, uniqueness, manifest count, availability gates, and complete live catalog presence before fetching any schema. Required stale rows abort without writing a baseline; absent optional/feature-gated rows remain explicit skipped diagnostics. Probe and full-scan per-action rows share one raw-evidence contract: successful rows carry canonical raw_schema, raw_schema_hash_kind, and raw_schema_sha256, and validation reruns score_schema_quality(raw_schema) then exact-compares all six dimensions, schema_score, and value_domain_diagnostics. Full scan checkpoints preserve only validated successful rows plus segment/outage provenance, reject input or catalog drift and duplicate result ids, and require an exact complete result set before summary publication.

full_scan_resume.raw_schema_score_derivation: score_schema_quality(raw_schema) must exactly equal all six dimension fields, schema_score, and value_domain_diagnostics
full_scan_resume.legacy_checkpoint_policy: Version-1 checkpoints and evidence are not migrated or accepted; existing diagnostic evidence has zero completion credit and the next probe/full run must emit version-2 rows.
